protocol.name: Standardized SOTA LLM Track
protocol.inputPolicy: All models receive the same OPTD instruction, state serialization, observation history, visual inputs, and executable action candidates for each evaluation setting.
controls: Fixed benchmark split and initial states
No model-specific prompt, tools, memory, retrieval, or retry policy
Uniform failure accounting with no fallback predictions
Exact provider model identifier, evaluation date, and accepted request parameters reported
